scope.implemented_contract: variational P0, E1, strict-C1, and separately named density-resummed-C1 nonlinear descendants of the accepted exact-Wilson Hartree and restricted pure-LDA Kohn-Sham actions
scope.fixture: equilateral H3+ with two electrons in cc-pVDZ/weigend and lda,vwn, stationary fields through Bz=0.06 au, three driven trajectories of length 2.0 au, and an STO-3G/cc-pVDZ/aug-cc-pVDZ reduced-domain stress scan
included: matched stationary energies, mixed and real-space densities, lower matrices, fixed-history source responses, and action-derived power
exact E1 reduction under a spatially uniform electric field at zero magnetic field
matched P0, E1, strict-C1, density-resummed-C1, and exact-Wilson nonlinear trajectories
independent N=16 versus N=32 timestep separation for both C1 actions
basis-dependent reduced-overlap positivity, conditioning, pointwise-density, and LDA-domain stress tests
independent exact-Wilson overlap recomputation at every basis/field stress point
visible retention of all nonpositive reduced-metric failures without clipping, regularization, correction, or projection
strict-C1 selection as the bounded working approximation because the resummed action showed no systematic accuracy, stability, or domain advantage
authenticated raw synthesis through immutable accepted NQ4 and NQ6 review records
deterministically repeated evidence analysis with identical summary hashes
focused CPU and physical-GPU regression coverage

effect: NQ7 accepted and NQ8 pure-GGA extension and broader molecular-transfer qualification authorized
limitations: the accepted physical comparison is bounded to one equilateral H3+ geometry, cc-pVDZ/weigend, one affine gauge representative, one pure LDA functional, the declared field amplitudes, and trajectories of length 2.0 au

the domain stress scan evaluates a fixed reference coefficient density and brackets sampled failures; it is not a stationary or dynamic campaign at every basis and field and does not locate a continuous critical field
reduced-metric validity is strongly basis conditioned, with all tested aug-cc-pVDZ reduced levels failing at the first nonzero sampled field Bz=0.03 au while the exact Wilson metric remains positive
C1 improves states and lower matrices but does not uniformly reduce every finite-field scalar energy or power error coefficient
density-resummed C1 remains a separately labeled diagnostic action and is not accepted as a repair or safer replacement for strict C1
the Kohn-Sham source current remains that of the declared auxiliary adiabatic pure-LDA action and is not accepted as an exact interacting transverse current
spatially nonuniform fields, moving nuclei, periodicity, GGA, pseudopotentials, Maxwell backreaction, longer trajectories, and chemical transfer are not accepted by this decision

executed_tests.physical_gpu_focused: 1 passed through tools/gpu-python, 1 expected CuPy contraction-engine warning
executed_tests.authenticated_raw_synthesis: 72/72 stationary, 96/96 domain, and 36/36 dynamic records; all 48 domain failures visible
executed_tests.deterministic_analysis_repetition: final and verification summary hashes identical

accepted_recommendation.reason: strict C1 is the controlled degree-one variational action, while density-resummed C1 showed the same sampled domain and no systematic numerical advantage

raw_artifact_policy: The completed raw campaign and both identical analysis passes remain immutable; this separate review record carries the user's acceptance decision.
